title: Petal usage v1
description: One model call, as it was counted and charged: NEAR AI's own id for the call, the tokens it reported, the list price they were counted at, what the person was charged, and NEAR AI's own bill once it's known. Kept for every call; only billed_usd and reconciled_at are filled in later.

call.description: NEAR AI's inference id for the call (its inference-id header, the id its billing knows), or null when there is none

run.description: the conversation it was part of

cached.description: of in, the ones NEAR AI read from its cache

list_price.description: dollars per million tokens it was counted at

failed_usd.description: what attempts that failed before this answer were counted at

charged_usd.description: what was taken for it when it answered: computed plus failed

billed_usd.description: NEAR AI's own bill for the call, once known; the difference from computed is given back or charged, as its own entry
